name: Pecky Clicker
summary:
In this clicker-style game, you must take care of a very special little cat named Pecky. Tap the screen nonstop to earn coins and multipliers, because Pecky does not like being hungry. With those coins, you can buy her water and food, because this cat is quite demanding. When you collect enough coins, you will unlock platformer and runner-style minigames to mix things up and keep earning rewards.

Everything was going fine until some aliens kidnapped Pecky’s dad, named Cristian. Without thinking twice, this brave cat jumped into her spaceship and went off to search for him in space. But things did not go as planned: the ship suffered a malfunction and Pecky ended up stranded in the middle of space. Now it is up to you to help her repair the ship by repeatedly tapping your phone screen with your human paw to earn tons of coins.

This is a classic clicker game where you generate coins both actively and passively. It features more than 20 main upgrades, over 200 secondary upgrades, plus boosters and permanent upgrades. All of this is wrapped in very cute and eye-catching 3D graphics.

Come play this space clicker game with Pecky and help her save her dad while you tap the screen like there is no tomorrow.
